scope: Eight unselected Books 10–16 lessons; AI-only streamlined source, target, structural, originality and sampled semantic review

automatedCoverage.allLessons: Fresh focused build and --check pass 8 lessons, 48 questions, 32 audio requests, 0 flags; source sentences match the respective case-insensitive target regex and all eight speaking target spans extract the taught expression; no selected lesson ID collision.
automatedCoverage.originality: 192 learner-facing English strings compared against all 2,604 source examples; one six-token match, 'can light the fuse of curiosity', is target-expression overlap for lesson 4120; no non-target six-token reuse found.

riskBasedManualChecks.evidence: Representative source, reply, scene and writing checks show 4103 distinguishes habitual refusal from reasoned objection and 4120 distinguishes a curiosity trigger from a completed investigation.

4128's writing 'it' refers to the missing-sketch obstacle resolved before the site visit, with Chinese spelling out the obstacle; 4140 uses remembered visual moments rather than a literal photograph or complete record.
Sampled assessment and EN/ZH models distinguish updated tracking from a one-time note, and uncertain memory details from blanket memory loss or certain error.
Sampled answers and changed-context models give concrete thought/interpretation for nourish the mind and identify a central purpose rather than a trivial error for miss the point entirely.

limits: Every lesson received automated structural/source/target/span/originality checks. Manual review was risk-based, with flagged and representative clean fields inspected; it was not a new line-by-line bilingual prose audit of all 48 questions. AI content clearance does not imply human media or publication sign-off.
